Devastator grants [ASSAULT] to ranged weapons; Assault and Tactical are captured as opaque eligibility grants. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Rapid-drop Deployment
community_notes: [APPROX] At the Declare Battle Formations step, grants Deep Strike to a battle-size-dependent number of selected non-TITANIC ADEPTUS ASTARTES units (modeled as 3 — strongest case; the per-battle-size table is not in the store text). The re-roll of Wound rolls of 1 for models set up this turn — and re-roll of Hit rolls of 1 if disembarked from a DROP POD — are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Shield of the Imperium
community_notes: [APPROX] Ranged weapons gain [HEAVY]; a weapon that already had [HEAVY] adds 1 to the Wound roll while the attacking unit Remained Stationary. The 'already had [HEAVY]' restriction is approximated by narrowing the +1 to weapons with the Heavy keyword. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Close-range Eradication
community_notes: Ranged weapons of ADEPTUS ASTARTES models gain [ASSAULT]; attacks from such weapons targeting a unit within 12" add 1 to the Strength characteristic.

name: Armoured Wrath
community_notes: [APPROX] Once per phase, each ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit may re-roll one Hit, Wound, or Damage roll (see 'usage'). The single-roll re-roll is modeled with subset 'all-failures' per the sibling convention. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Rapid Deployment
community_notes: [APPROX] After disembarking from a TRANSPORT, the unit makes a Normal move of up to D6" (modeled as a reactive move). The D3+3" HEAVY TRANSPORT variant and the 'transport made a Normal/Advance move this phase, excluding arrivals from Strategic Reserves' qualifiers are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Interlocking Tactics
community_notes: [APPROX] ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE units become eligible to shoot/declare a charge and to start Actions in a turn they Advanced or Fell Back (captured as opaque eligibility grants). The auspex-scanned mark placed on an enemy unit hit by a BATTLELINE unit — and the resulting re-roll of Hit rolls of 1 against auspex-scanned units — are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Adaptive Defence
community_notes: [APPROX] Models the re-roll of Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. The gating condition — the attacking unit being within a terrain feature — has no DSL predicate and is not modeled, nor is the separate conditional ENTRENCHED keyword grant. Full rule in raw-text store.
